spots.label: Your desk
lines: Your desk is a door on four legs. The company is proud of that.

spots.label: Maya's desk
lines: Stuck is fine. Stuck and silent for an hour is the only thing I mind.
When you ask for help, tell me what you tried first. It saves us both ten minutes.
I still look things up every day. Nobody carries all of this in their head.

spots.label: Dev's desk
lines: I was the intern last year. First week I pushed straight to main. The pipeline said no, loudly.
If the Beta stage is red, it is probably that flaky test again. Probably.
Ping-pong later? The table is by the elevators.

spots.label: Priya's desk
lines: If my CR looks tiny, read it twice. The tiny ones are where I get careless.
On-call next week. I am already tired.
Good reviewers ask questions. Great ones ask the question I was hoping nobody would.

spots.label: Rohan's corner
lines: My job is to decide what matters most this sprint. Your job is to tell me early when it will not fit.
I do not count hours. I notice what shipped, and what was promised and did not.
Bring me bad news while it is still small.

spots.label: Sam, on the sofa
lines: Half the tickets on your board started as a customer complaining to me.
I do not tell engineers how to build it. I tell them who is asking and why it hurts.
"Not urgent but also kind of urgent" is a real priority level, thank you.

spots.label: Coffee machine
lines: The coffee is free. Lunch is not: frugality is a company value.

spots.label: Banana stand
lines: Free bananas for anyone who walks past. The one perk nobody argues about.

spots.label: Ping-pong table
lines: Dev is always up for a quick game. First to three points.

spots.label: Window
lines: It is raining. It is usually raining.
Food trucks are lining up on the street below.
